_comment: One entry per benchmarked model. 'backend' picks the provider: openrouter / huggingface / copilot (openai-compatible; copilot is the local Copilot API Gateway, streamed) or local (llamacpp-jni, GGUF under modelDir). 'settings' are copied verbatim into the srcMorph aiDefinition; the common settings below apply first. 'origin' marks the June 2026 benchmark models.

models.name: Gemma 4 31B it (reasoning off)
models.note: reasoning switched off with reasoning.effort none; at effort low the route reasons as well (163 reasoning tokens for a one-line test method)

models.name: Nemotron 3.5 Lightning 30B-A3B
models.note: reasoning tokens count against max_tokens; at the common 4096 most answers came back empty

models.name: Nemotron 3.5 Lightning 30B-A3B (reasoning off)
models.note: reasoning switched off with reasoning.effort none; at effort low the same route spent the output budget on reasoning

models.name: Qwen3.5-35B-A3B
models.note: reasoning tokens count against max_tokens; at the common 4096 most answers came back empty

models.name: Qwen3.5-35B-A3B (reasoning off)
models.note: reasoning switched off with reasoning.effort none; at effort low the same route spent the output budget on reasoning

models.name: Qwen3.8-27B (reasoning off)
models.note: reasoning switched off with reasoning.effort none; at effort low the route reasons as well (25 reasoning tokens for a one-line test method)

models.name: Mistral Large 4
models.note: reasoning cannot be switched off (Mistral answers reasoning_effort none with HTTP 400), and reasoning tokens count against max_tokens: at the common 4096, 9 of 37 files came back empty

models.name: Mercury 3
models.note: Inception's diffusion language model

models.name: Claude Haiku 5.5 (OpenRouter)
models.note: the same model as claude-haiku-5.5, through OpenRouter instead of GitHub Copilot: shows what the route changes and what it costs

models.name: Muse Spark 1.3 (Contributor)
models.note: Meta's contributor tier (0.10 / 0.20 USD per million tokens against 1.25 / 4.25 for the standard tier); third-party sources report that its prompts are used to train Meta's models, so it suits public code only

models.name: Nemotron 3.5 Super VL 120B-A12B (reasoning off)
models.note: reasoning switched off with reasoning.effort none; at effort low 3 of 24 file summaries spent the whole 4096-token budget reasoning and came back empty

models.name: MAI-Code-1.1-Flash
models.note: GitHub Copilot through the Copilot API Gateway VS Code extension (docs/copilot-api-gateway.md); max_input_tokens 127790, so the window stays below it

models.name: GPT-6 Luna (Copilot)
models.note: the same model as gpt-6-luna, through GitHub Copilot instead of OpenRouter: shows what the route changes

models.name: Grok 4.7
models.note: through GitHub Copilot: on OpenRouter (x-ai/grok-4.7, reasoning mandatory) xAI refused the run after 8 files with 403 'This service is not available in your region'

models.name: Gemma 4 12B it (Q4_K_M, thinking off)
models.note: llama.cpp renders Gemma 4 with thinking on unless told otherwise; with it on, every Java file of gemma-4-12b spent the whole 4096-token budget reasoning

models.name: Gemma 4 E4B it (Q4_K_M, thinking off)
models.note: llama.cpp renders Gemma 4 with thinking on unless told otherwise; with it on, every Java file of gemma-4-12b spent the whole 4096-token budget reasoning

models.name: Granite 4.2 8B (Q4_K_M, thinking off)
models.note: the template thinks unless enable_thinking is false

models.name: LFM 2.5 24B-A2B (Q4_K_M)
models.note: the template always opens a <think> block and has no switch, so reasoning counts against the output budget: 16 384 tokens

models.name: gpt-oss-20b (MXFP4, local)
models.note: the same model as gpt-oss-20b, locally with its native MXFP4 experts (ggml-org GGUF, 2026-10) instead of on OpenRouter

models.name: Kolibri-1 (Q4_K_M, thinking off)
models.note: Aleph Alpha's 78B-A3.5B MoE (October 2026, Apache 2.0); the attention and shared weights on the 8 GB GPU, all 50 expert layers in RAM (cpuMoeLayers); with 4 expert layers on the GPU as well, VRAM overflowed into shared system memory and the first file was generated at 2.3 instead of 4.2 tokens/s (about 25 once the weights are in RAM). Kolibri's template reads reasoning_effort before enable_thinking, and srcmorph sent its default low as that kwarg, so with enable_thinking false alone the first file spent the whole 4096-token budget reasoning; the run set reasoningEffort none. srcmorph now omits reasoning_effort while enable_thinking is false, and the template renders the same prompt as with none
